values_by_component.notes: Canonical prognostic fields only; packet mirrors and reset daily accumulators are excluded.

forcing_days.representation: forcing_native plus deterministic preprocessing, annual_conditions, and landpoint_static
forcing_days.notes: The shard stores five native 6-hour records, not expanded 48-step forcing.

science_day_numbers.notes: Calendar features are derived after loading and are not duplicated in the shard.

stomate_parameters.notes: Named alloc_min, residence_time, vcmax25, and maint_resp_slope PFT vectors.

hydrol_table_arrays.representation: derived from named landpoint_static soil and hydrology conditions plus global constants
hydrol_table_arrays.notes: Derived CWRR interpolation tables are not stored as a second independent input.

landpoint_payload.representation: dynamic vegetation fields in state; atmospheric fields in forcing; physical point fields in landpoint_static
landpoint_payload.notes: Raw kindex and neighbour IDs are addressing metadata, not neural features.

stomate_restart_template.representation: evolving values in state; invariant structural values in code/config
stomate_restart_template.notes: The restart object is a Teacher packet-construction template, not an independent daily observation.

stomate_season_values.notes: Season memory must not be supplied as a second, potentially inconsistent condition vector.

diffuco_parameter_values.representation: vcmax25 and other selected tunable values in parameters; invariant PFT constants in code/config
diffuco_parameter_values.notes: Any newly tunable DIFFUCO parameter must be promoted to a named parameter leaf before dataset generation.

promotion_rule: A value that varies across accepted landpoints, years, forcing products, or supported parameter experiments and can affect the transition must appear in state, daily exogenous input, annual conditions, or a named condition leaf.
